note: Frozen ceiling snapshot for hotspot-budgets.json. A budget is a ceiling, not a floor, so its ratchet direction is the opposite of a coverage floor's: a live budget may only stay the same or tighten (decrease); it may never loosen (increase) past its frozen value here. Raise this baseline only by deliberately re-capturing it from a reviewed hotspot-budgets.json change, never to wave through a value that grew merely to make a change pass.
